# Templates

Copy these into private Google Sheets. Do not fill them in inside the repository; they will contain personal data.

- `prospects.csv` — one row per prospect. Allowed values: `segment` A/B/C; `contact_status` not_contacted / contacted / replied / declined / no_response; `interview_status` not_scheduled / scheduled / done / no_show; `problem_frequency` weekly / monthly / quarterly / rare; `wtp_evidence` commitment-ladder level 0–4 plus a note; `concierge_candidate` yes/no.
- `concierge/leads.csv`, `concierge/tagihan.csv`, `concierge/followup.csv` — the three tabs of one concierge sheet per participant. See `../CONCIERGE_TEST.md` for the formulas to add in the follow-up tab.
